secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Anthropic API key powering the financial brain (server-side replies in /api/jeff). Without it the app runs in scripted mode. Get it from https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys.

secrets.name: ADMIN_EMAILS
secrets.description: Comma-separated emails of people who can open the Admin screen to add companies and make team codes, e.g. you@yourcompany.com. Sign up with that email first.
